title: kit.form-notification.v1
description: One form submission and its two deliveries (docs/FORMS.md). $defs.submission is the body of the comms engine's POST /v1/comms/submit (what a site's form handler hands over, through @saasreport/comms submitForm); the root is the record the engine keeps in D1 (comms_form_deliveries), answers that call with, serves at GET /api/forms/deliveries/<reference> and hands to onEvent as comms.form.delivered or comms.form.owner_failed. It carries no address and no submitted value: the contents travel in the emails, the ledger keeps statuses. An owner delivery that is not `sent` is a failure (suppressed included): it is recorded, raised as an event and counted by GET /api/forms/deliveries, which the monitor's form-deliveries journey reads.

test.description: A test or drill submission (marked TEST in the subject of both emails); its receipt goes to the owner's recipients, never to the address in the form.

reference.description: <prefix>-<16 characters of the 32-letter alphabet A-HJ-NP-Z2-9>: 80 bits from the platform's CSPRNG (newReference in @saasreport/core/form-deliveries). The ledger link in the owner's notification is the reference, so it is long enough that the reference cannot be guessed, and its lookup is rate-limited per client.

status.description: pending: not finished (a pending owner delivery older than the monitor's window is a failure); suppressed: the recipient asked not to be written to (a receipt only: an owner delivery is never suppressed, it fails).

dispatch_id.description: The comms_dispatch row of this email, when the engine reserved one.

error.description: Why it failed: an error code and detail, never an address.

form_label.description: The form's name in the owner's notification (default: the form id).

params.description: The acknowledgement template's params (name, reference, submitted_at, fields_html, fields_text and the template's own); the owner's notification gets the same submission (fields_html, fields_text) plus form_id, form_label, site, ledger_url and test_marker from the engine.

locale.description: The submitter's language (BCP 47; its first subtag picks the autoreply variant, the form's `ack_templates`). A language the project does not declare gets the primary one.

notices.description: The legal-notice pick of the receipt (dispatch `notices`).

summary.description: GET /api/forms/deliveries: counts over the window, no reference, no address. ok is false when an owner delivery failed or is pending past pending_after_min.

last_test_at.description: When the latest test (drill) submission in the window was recorded: the monitor drills once a day, never twice.

manifestForm.description: One entry of the comms manifest's `forms`: the autoreply exists once per declared locale (`ack_templates`, keyed by language; `ack_template_id` is the primary locale's). Every variant is refused on plain /v1/comms/dispatch, and a submission's `locale` picks its variant.

submitAnswer.description: The answer of POST /v1/comms/submit. `delivery` is the ledger record (the root of this schema). `outcome_recorded: false` appears only when the engine's final write of the outcome failed; a caller that sees `error` and no `delivery` records the failure itself (submitForm).

outcome_recorded.description: Appears only when the final write of the outcomes failed after the row existed (and possibly after both emails went): the submission IS recorded, its row stays pending and the summary counts it as failed once stale. Never a reason to ask the submitter to submit again.
